title: Ex 1.2 #2(c) · A × A
prompt: Let $A = \{\pi, e, 0\}$ and $B = \{0, 1\}$. List the elements of $A \times A$ between braces.
answer_format: A set of ordered pairs between braces, like {(1, a), (2, b)}. Spaces are optional. Steps are optional.
hints: Pair every element of the first set with every element of the second; the first entry of each pair comes from the first set.
The product has (size of first set) × (size of second set) elements: you need 9.
solution: Pair each element of the first set with each element of the second.

reference.note: This exact exercise, restated in ProofLab's words.
